1. (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25°C of __at least 10 cps__ at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, __and wherein the MAAC comprises bevacizumab__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a solution.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

4. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein __the ocular condition involves__ angiogenesis and the MAAC comprises a direct or indirect inhibitor of a vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein the MAAC comprises __a polypeptide__.

7. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a nucleic acid.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein said nucleic acid comprises a therapeutic agent selected from the group consisting of an aptamer, an RNAi, a ribozyme, and an antisense oligonucleotide.

9. (Original) The method of claim 8 wherein said MAAC comprises a therapeutic agent selected from the group consisting of siRNA Z, pegaptanib, and Cand5.

10. (Original) The method of claim 8 wherein said MAAC comprises at least one nucleic acid having a nucleic acid sequence having at least 80% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from the group consisting of SEQ ID NO:1, SEQ ID NO:2, SEQ ID NO:3, SEQ ID NO:4, SEQ ID NO:5, SEQ ID NO:6, SEQ ID NO:7, SEQ ID NO:8, SEQ ID NO:9, SEQ ID NO:10, SEQ ID NO:11, SEQ ID NO:14, SEQ ID NO:15, SEQ ID NO:22, and SEQ ID NO:23, and nucleotide sequences corresponding to any of these containing at least one modified nucleotide.

11. (Original) The method of claim 10 wherein said nucleic acid has a nucleotide sequence having at least 90% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from said group.

12. (Original) The method of claim 11 wherein said nucleic acid has a nucleotide sequence having at least 95% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from said group.

13. (Original) The method of claim 11 wherein said nucleic acid has at least 95% identity to a nucleotide sequence selected from said group.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein __that is an angiogenesis inhibitor__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein is __an angiogenesis inhibitor__.

16. (Original) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein comprises a therapeutic agent selected form the group consisting of ADNECTIN® CT-322, ADNECTIN® C7S100, ADNECTIN® C7C100, rambizumab, bevacizumab, urokinase peptide inhibitor A6, cisplatin, rapamycin, endostatin, angiostatin, tumstatin, pigment epithelium derived factor, and VEGF TRAP®, IMC-18F1 and IMC-1121 Fab.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises __hyaluronic acid__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range from about 10,000 Daltons to about 2 million Daltons __and wherein the viscosity inducing component is present in an amount of at least 0.5% by weight__.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 100,000 Daltons to about 1.5 million Daltons.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 21 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 200,000 Daltons to about 1 million Daltons.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 100 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 1000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 10,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

27. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 70,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

28. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 200,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 250,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

30. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component has a viscosity of __at least 300,000 cps__ at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition is administered to the interior of said eye by placement into the posterior segment of the eye through a 27-gauge needle.

32. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition comprises a condition of the posterior segment of the eye.

33. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.

34. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.

35. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said condition is __macular degeneration__.

36. (Currently amended) A pharmaceutical composition for intravitreal administration to treat an ocular condition comprising a MAAC __that is bevacizumab__ and a high viscosity hyaluronic acid carrier __wherein the composition has a viscosity of at least 10 cps at a shear rate of 0.1/second at 25°C__.
